Mission Local reported that Mayor Daniel Lurie accepted an amendment exempting buildings with three or more rent-controlled apartments from the upzoning plan. The newsroom’s analysis said the exemption covered at least 84,000 rental units in 11,700 buildings, plus any ground-floor retail beneath them. Two-unit buildings were not covered; about 20,700 remained in the plan. The story said the amendment responded to concerns that the plan could spur demolition of pre-1979 housing, the only housing subject to city rent control.
